# CloudCorpRecords

> CloudCorpRecords is the open-source home of Rene Turcios
> (San Francisco): deterministic tools that measure what actually
> stops AI agents on the web — bot walls, agent-contribution
> policy, package health — with the evidence shown. The campaign's
> rules: measurement in public, signed agent identity (Web Bot
> Auth, RFC 9421), documented front doors. No bypass tooling.

## Sites

- [CloudCorpRecords home](https://cloudcorprecords.github.io/): This site — who, what, and the machine-readable files.
- [GitHub — CloudCorpRecords](https://github.com/CloudCorpRecords): 150+ public repositories, including Greenlight, mcpaudit, and shipcheck.
- [Rene Turcios — portfolio](https://reneturcios.replit.app/): Live projects, press, case studies, and speaking.
- [Clipwise](https://clipwise.replit.app/): AI video clipping; a web studio agents can also call via MCP.

## Machine files on this site

- [robots.txt](https://cloudcorprecords.github.io/robots.txt)
- [sitemap.xml](https://cloudcorprecords.github.io/sitemap.xml)
